A '''second mission''' to [[Alashan]] was assigned to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Mici Shabandar]] and the droids [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==The mission==
===Prelude===
After stealing the ''[[Staraker]]'', a new secret Imperial warship, Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa, Mich Shabandar and the droids R2-D2 and C-3PO were sent to the planet Alashan. They crash-landed into the lava covering the planet. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] finally dug their way out of the hardened lava only to be captured by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Wil'm Grau]] and his men. The Imperials were without a ship, and Grau agreed to search the planet together under a banner of truce. The team finally found a destroyed Rebel archaeologist camp which had been working on an underground tunnel. The entire team decided to search the tunnel. Unknown to the group, they were being stalked by a [[Sentinel (creature)|beast]] native to the planet.

===Journey throughout the City of Forever===
Along with [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Wil'm Grau]], the team entered an [[Unidentified Alashan city|underground city]] and went exploring. There, Leia found strange markings on the walls of the city. She felt like she was familiar with them, but didn't know how. Leia, walking alone on a bridge, was attacked by the [[Sentinel (creature)|Sentinel creature]]. Luke rescued her by pushing Leia off the bridge, causing the both of them to fall off of the bridge. They were soon reunited with the group. After a hunt in which the Sentinel almost killed the team, Leia Organa found the source of the Sentinel's power in the [[Alashan control center]]. Upon destroying the structure, they were able to destroy the Sentinel. After digging out of the rubble, the team boarded the ''[[Staraker]]'' and Organa offers Grau a place in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. However, he declined, leaving the ship in a scoutboat. As the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] left the planet, the destroyed underground city came to life and a cryptic laughing resounded through the complex.

===Aftermath===
Grau and Anarine then left the world in the ''Staraker'' with the Rebels, where Organa offered Grau a position in the Rebel Alliance. However, Grau declined, and he and Anarine left the ship in a scoutboat to return to the Empire. The Rebel group then returned back to the Rebel Alliance's main base.
